title: AgentExecutionEvent
description: ADR-057 D1 — one canonical, append-only execution journal event. `session_urn + seq` is unique and strictly increasing. Bodies are losslessly JSON-serialisable; corrections append a compensating event rather than mutating. Routes through the ADR-005 events adapter and inherits its privacy/linked-data/observability boundaries.

schema.description: Envelope schema id + version. A consumer may depend only on the canonical fields.

event_id.description: Stable per-event identity for idempotency. A retried append with the same event_id is a no-op. Minted as a urn:agentbox:event when the caller does not supply one.

session_urn.description: Owning interactive session (urn:agentbox:...). Together with seq forms the unique, strictly increasing key.

seq.description: Per-session monotonic sequence. Contiguous from 0; assigned by the journal, never by the caller.

occurred_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the recorded fact.

harness.description: Producing harness: claude | codex | ruflo | mcp | management-api | ...

agent_did.description: did:nostr:<hex> of the acting agent identity (ADR-043 session boundary).

step.description: Optional step ordinal within the turn.

type.description: Canonical minimum vocabulary (ADR-057 D1). Harness-specific detail rides payload.ext, never a new top-level type a consumer must know.

payload.description: Losslessly JSON-serialisable event body. Harness-specific fields live under payload.ext.<harness>.

correlation.description: Optional id grouping related events across sessions/turns.

causation.description: Optional event_id of the event that caused this one (D4 causation preservation).

privacy_class.description: Privacy classification consumed by the ADR-008 privacy filter middleware.
